subject: Request: short sandbox respite due to infra blocker — Alpha Instruments
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir@alphainstruments.com>
Cc: Priya Agarwal <priya.agarwal@alphainstruments.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 09:12:30 -0700
Subject: Request: short sandbox respite due to infra blocker — Alpha Instruments

Hi Samir / Priya,

Following up from our standup — I saw the error traces your team sent and it looks like the connector is hitting a protobuf incompatibility during our SDK handshake. I know you have devs blocked on the adapter integration and that your pilot window is tightening.

Can we provision an additional 3-week sandbox cushion and top up the trial credits so your engineers have runway to finish the adapter + end-to-end QA? We can also schedule a 90-minute co-debug session with one of our infra engineers to help unblock the handshake.

I've attached the integration-log.txt you shared earlier for reference. If this is helpful, I can loop in finance for a no-cost top-up approval and fast-track the credits.

Next steps I propose:
- Confirm 3-week extension and top-up of 150k token credits
- Schedule co-debug session (options: Mon/Wed afternoons PT)
- Get signoff from your PM on revised pilot dates

Appreciate the context — want to keep your pilot momentum.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
H: (415) 555-0124 | hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: integration-log.txt (text)
From: Samir Rao <samir@alphainstruments.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Agarwal <priya.agarwal@alphainstruments.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short sandbox respite due to infra blocker — Alpha Instruments

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the quick note and for looking at the logs. Confirmed — our infra lead hit the protobuf mismatch yesterday and the fix is non-trivial because the adapter vendor uses a patched runtime. We're asking for a two-week extension initially but a 3-week window would be ideal in case QA finds follow-on issues.

We'd also welcome a co-debug session; Mondays work best for us.

If you can get a no-cost top-up and the extra sandbox time it would keep our CRO from pausing the pilot. I'll have our PM, Priya, send an updated timeline after the session.

Appreciate the help — Samir
Samir Rao
VP Product, Alpha Instruments
samir@alphainstruments.com

Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 13:45:07 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Respite request from Alpha Instruments — approval needed

Marcus / Kimberly,

Forwarding the thread with Alpha Instruments. They are blocked on an SDK/protobuf issue and are asking for a 3-week sandbox cushion and a top-up of 150k trial token credits at no charge. They also want a co-debug session.

Context: this opportunity is on a pilot path (Deal DL-2028-0419-ALPHA). If we don't provide the runway they will likely pause the pilot and push evaluation to next quarter.

Asks:
- Can we approve a 3-week no-cost sandbox extension and 150k token credit top-up?
- Approve one 90-minute co-debug session with an infra engineer (we can bill consulting time later if needed).

I've included the integration logs (integration-log.txt) in case you want to review before approving.

Thanks,
Hannah
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: integration-log.txt (text)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Mar 2028 08:20:14 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Respite request from Alpha Instruments — approval needed

Hannah —

I'm fine approving a 3-week sandbox extension and the 150k token top-up at no charge given this is a pilot and the integration issue is on a vendor runtime. Please log the increment against DL-2028-0419-ALPHA in HubSpot (I've added DEAL-419 to the related links).

Two notes:
1) Add a one-time "co-debug" SOW note so we track hours (we won't invoice unless the session exceeds the agreed scope).
2) If the pilot extends beyond the additional 3 weeks, offer a 20% discount on the first production month rather than more free credits — prevents indefinite runway.

Attached my approval memo (approval-note.pdf). Proceed to confirm with the customer and schedule the debug session Monday/Wednesday.

-Marcus
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: approval-note.pdf (pdf)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Request: short sandbox respite due to infra blocker — Alpha Instruments

Samir / Priya —

Good news: Marcus approved a no-cost 3-week sandbox extension and a 150k token credit top-up for DL-2028-0419-ALPHA. We've also put a one-time co-debug session on the calendar (90 minutes) — options next week: Mon 26 Mar 1:30–3:00 PM PT or Wed 28 Mar 2:00–3:30 PM PT. Please confirm which slot works for your engineering lead.

I'll log the credit adjustment in HubSpot and upload the approval note to our deal folder. If the pilot needs more time after the 3 weeks, we'll offer a 20% first-month production discount rather than additional free credits.

Thanks for flagging quickly — want to keep the momentum.

Best,
